links.outcome: Correctness, omissions and harmfulness of LLM therapy recommendations rated by physicians
links.effect: Significant differences in falseness across models and specialties (P<.001); errors included confusing diagnoses, vague advice, omitting critical treatments such as antibiotics for infectious diseases.
links.quote: Distinct error patterns emerged, such as confusing diagnoses; providing vague, ambiguous advice; or omitting critical treatments, such as antibiotics for infectious diseases.

links.outcome: LLM failure to detail treatment risks, quality-of-life effects, and additional information sources
links.effect: All models lagged in detailing treatment procedure risks, explaining therapy effects on quality of life, and offering additional information sources.
links.quote: All models lagged in detailing the risks associated with treatment procedures, explaining the effects of therapies on quality of life, and offering additional sources of information.

unlisted_practices: Automated LLM-as-judge (GPT-4) evaluation of LLM outputs compared with physician assessments (Pearson correlation)

screen.reason: Empirical study benchmarking the quality, correctness, and harmfulness of therapeutic recommendations generated by four LLMs across three medical specialties using physician review and automated GPT-4 evaluation.
